title: C9 remainder: under a wall, Setup's catalog editors (position, permission set, capability) are read-only for tenants and say why — the server already refuses (objectstack#22895)
body:
Part of #7611

**Handed out of the objectstack#15194 epic subtree to the `domain:ui` lane.** The epic PM (`session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR`, `marchtian`) did this at the maintainer's request in its session on 2026-10-12: clear next-step work that can be built ahead goes to lane PMs, and the maintainer's tasks are high priority (`priority:p1`). This card is the lane's claim surface. #7611 stays open with the epic seat for its other parts.

## The gap (measured by code read; the lane measures it in a browser first)
- #7611's body: catalog pages are "read-only for tenants under a wall (the server refuses anyway; the UI explains why)".
- Seat ACCEPT 6114624010 on #12164 recorded the gap:
  - on objectui `main`, the metadata admin's writability gate does not read the posture (`useTenancyPosture`, `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useTenancyPosture.ts:55`, is not consulted there);
  - a walled tenant **without** `manage_metadata` is already read-only through `useCanAuthorMetadata`;
  - a walled tenant **with** it is offered Save, Clone, New and Activate.
- **objectstack#22895 (stage W) merged** at 2026-10-12T03:43Z as `06cc45dc36`. Under `isolated` / `group`, every door now refuses an organization-scoped principal's write to an environment-level `position` / `permission` / `capability` item with 403 naming the posture. The platform operator keeps the writes. So today the console offers actions the server refuses.

## Scope
1. **Measure first**, on objectui `main` against objectstack `main` (`06cc45dc36` or later), under `isolated` or `group` with a tenant admin holding `manage_metadata`:
   - which catalog surfaces offer a write: the editors, Clone, New, Activate/Deactivate, and the holder-assignment halves;
   - what the server answers for each.
   Also measure an operator (platform admin) as the control. Its writes must stay offered.
2. **Build:**
   - The catalog types become read-only for a walled tenant, with one sentence saying why (a server rule, not a missing permission).
   - The operator keeps write.
   - Assignments (who holds a position or set) stay writable for tenants: "tenants are refused creation and may only assign" (objectstack triage pointer 6070695107).
   - Read the posture and the caller's operator standing from what the server already publishes. ⛔ Do not re-implement the server's verdict. ⛔ Invent no spec field (objectui AGENTS.md #0/#0.1).
3. **Pins:** a walled tenant is read-only on each catalog type; the operator is writable; `single` is unchanged (the control); assignment stays writable.

## Boundaries
- W2 (objectstack, in flight) adds the same refusal for installing a catalog-carrying package. Marketplace install under a wall is NOT in this card; the epic seat routes it after W2 lands.
- ⛔ No stacked PRs; base `main`.
- Coordination: post on this card; the epic seat reads it.
- Re-verify that no branch or PR already does this (the maintainer's 「不要重复开发」).

## Refs
#7611 · objectstack#22895 (stage W) · objectstack ADR-0131 D3 ("the server refuses anyway") · seat ACCEPT 6114624010 · objectstack triage pointer 6070695107.
